description: This file initializes the React application by rendering the main App component into the DOM element with id 'root'. It imports necessary modules including React, ReactDOM, a CSS stylesheet, and the main App component.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering a React component tree into the DOM.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the DOM inside the created root.
